A significant decrease in acetate levels was detected in patients who developed GvHD (log2FC median = −2.36; p = 0.049).

↓ LRTI
The incidence of viral LRTI at 180 days was 17.3% and 16.1% for groups in which butyrate-producing bacteria were absent or low, respectively, and 3.2% for the high butyrate-producing group (p = 0.005).
Patients with the highest abundance of butyrate-producing bacteria were independently associated with a fivefold decrease in risk of viral LRTI (HR 0.22; 95% CI 0.04–0.69; p = 0.06).
